case_title: Manju Devi v. State of Rajasthan & Anr.
neutral_facts: The accused, who is the husband of the deceased, is facing trial for the murder of his wife, who died under unnatural circumstances in Nigeria. The deceased's body was brought to India, and a Medical Board conducted a post-mortem, but could not determine the cause of death. The first post-mortem was conducted by a doctor in Nigeria, whose testimony was deemed essential to the case. The trial court rejected the application to summon the doctor as a witness, citing the availability of the post-mortem report. The High Court also dismissed the appeal, but the Supreme Court allowed the appeal, directing the trial court to ensure the testimony of the Nigerian doctor is recorded through video-conferencing or by issuing a commission.
